critical_assertions.note: Misclosure of ~0.98 ft is significant. This is the L-shaped main parcel (Lot 11.01) that wraps from Kings Highway West along Washington Avenue. The large misclosure may be due to the complex shape with 8 sides and a notch (calls 6-7-8) where Lot 12 inserts into the boundary. The 2013 survey by Macnamara may have used different control than the 2003 JTS survey.

common_failure_modes: 8-sided L-shaped parcel is complex - may confuse simple parsers
Calls 6 and 8 share the same bearing (N 59d02' E) but run along different boundaries (Kings Hwy vs Lot 12 line)
The notch formed by calls 6-7-8 where Lot 12 meets Lot 11.01 creates a concave boundary
Large misclosure (~0.98 ft) suggests the deed description itself has survey inconsistency
POB location uses 85.00 feet (round number) which is unusual for a surveyed point
notes: This is the main 8 Kings Highway West parcel (Lot 11.01), the L-shaped lot that wraps from Kings Highway West around to Washington Avenue. It was the commercial building parcel retained when the larger parcel was subdivided for the Willits Court townhouses. Sold in 2013 by 8 Kings Highway LLC to Kings Hall LLC for $522,000. The 8-sided shape results from: Washington Ave frontage (call 1), the notch boundary with the Willits Court lots (calls 2-3-4), the Lot 11 boundary (call 5), Kings Highway frontage (call 6), and the Lot 12 jog (calls 7-8). The ~0.98 ft misclosure is notable and may indicate a survey discrepancy in the 2013 Macnamara survey. Legal description rebuilt 2026-10-31 from the recorded PDF (Book 9787 Pages 1784-1785, PDF pages 1-2); the previous text was a placeholder ("thence (1) through (8) to the point and place of beginning"). All eight courses match the deed as printed, so the ~0.98 ft misclosure is the deed's own.
